events.category: Japanese singer-songwriter / cultural exchange / anime-music crossover
events.factual_description: Kazuso Oda a.k.a. Coda performs at The Jazz Gallery, 1158 Broadway, 5th Floor, New York, on Sunday, November 8, 2026. Oda's official site lists doors at 1:30 PM and a 2:00 PM start and describes the date as his first North American live appearance under his own name, with a special band set using local musicians. The authorized Eventbrite listing by organizer DWDP describes the engagement as his first North American solo concert and the first time he has brought a full-band format outside Japan. It says the program will include songs from the August 5, 2026 monologue e.p., older Kazusou Oda material, and songs performed under his Coda alias, including BLOODY STREAM from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure; it also identifies Michael Massiah on guitar, Hiroyuki Sakaba on bass, and Shinya Miyamoto on drums. The event is independently produced and is not part of The Jazz Gallery's official season programming. Oda's official site publishes early-bird admission at $38 through September 30, general admission at $45 from October 1 through November 7, and $50 at the door, with Eventbrite as the advance ticket destination.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to care is the translation happening onstage. For his first North American solo show, Oda is not simply exporting a Japanese touring band: he is building a one-off New York rhythm section around his current singer-songwriter material and then folding the Coda catalog that carried his voice into global anime culture back into the same set. The first U.S. live outing for monologue e.p. and the first full-band Oda performance outside Japan make this a concrete Japan-to-New-York exchange rather than a generic overseas booking.
en.trip_verdict: If a New York trip already overlaps November 8, attend if convenient; the Sunday-afternoon timing makes it an easy addition before an evening show. I would not make a dedicated DMV-to-New-York trip for this date alone, but it is a distinctive stop if the city is already on the calendar.

es.why_it_matters: Lo interesante es la traducción que ocurre en el escenario. Para su primer concierto solista en Norteamérica, Oda no trae simplemente una banda japonesa de gira: arma una sección rítmica con músicos de Nueva York alrededor de su material actual como cantautor y, en el mismo set, vuelve a conectar con el repertorio de Coda que llevó su voz a la cultura global del anime. El primer recorrido en vivo por Estados Unidos de monologue e.p. y su primera presentación de banda completa fuera de Japón convierten la fecha en un intercambio concreto entre Japón y Nueva York, no en un booking internacional cualquiera.
es.trip_verdict: Si un viaje a Nueva York ya coincide con el 8 de noviembre, entraría si queda cómodo; el horario de domingo por la tarde permite sumarlo sin comerse necesariamente la noche. No haría un viaje dedicado desde el DMV sólo por esta fecha, pero sí es una parada distinta si la ciudad ya está en el calendario.
